plugin.name: Replace the vanilla dragon armour
plugin.description: The dragonplate and dragonscale armour the game already has - worn by you, sold by smiths, forged at the forge - becomes this armour. A light plugin points vanilla's armour addon records at these meshes, so another mod can supersede it by load order.

plugin.name: Add it as a separate set
plugin.description: Vanilla's dragon armour is left exactly as it is. Ten new pieces - Nordic Dragonplate and Nordic Dragonscale cuirass, boots, gauntlets, helmet and shield - are forged at any forge with the Dragon Armor perk and tempered at the workbench, with the vanilla pieces' stats, materials and costs record for record.

plugin.name: Both
plugin.description: The vanilla dragon armour becomes this armour, and the ten Nordic pieces are added as their own craftable set as well. Two light plugins.

plugin.name: Standard
plugin.description:
The finish as NordwarUA and QuestionableKhajiit made it: brown leather, oxblood cloth and gold fittings against bone-coloured scale.
Pictured: dragonplate on the left, dragonscale on the right.

plugin.name: Black Edition
plugin.description:
The same armour with the leather, cloth and fittings taken down to black and unpolished steel. The scale itself is unchanged, so the set reads darker without losing the bone.
Pictured: dragonplate on the left, dragonscale on the right.
